title: Rotor
text: Compute aerodynamic forces and moments, 9 inputs, 4 outputs, {Units} sets Input and output units Metric; {Modeling} sets the rotor thrust calculation method Without flap, {Include pitch angle inputs} enables pitch angle inputs, {CT and CQ Source} sets the dropdown to select the source of thrust and torque coefficient, {Thrust coefficient (CT)}, {Torque coefficient (CQ)} sets the torque coefficient 7.8263e-4, {Number of blades}, {Output computed CT and CQ} sets the output computed thrust coefficient and torque, {Radius (m)} sets the rotor radius, {Chord (m)} sets the blade chord, {Hinge offset (m)}, {Lift curve slope (per rad)}, {Mean drag coefficient}, {Lock number}, {Twist distribution} sets the rotor blade twist, {Blade root angle (rad)} sets the blade root pitch angle, {Blade twist angle (rad)} and {Blade tip angle (rad)} sets the blade tip pitch angle. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: V b
ports.summary: Body velocity of rotor 3-by-1 vector | 1-by-3 vector

ports.name: C T
ports.summary: Input thrust coefficient nonzero positive scalar

ports.name: C Q
ports.summary: Input torque coefficient nonzero positive scalar

params.name: Units
params.values: Input and output units Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Modeling
params.values: Rotor thrust calculation method Without flap effects (default) | With flap effects

params.name: Include pitch angle inputs
params.values: Enable pitch angle inputs off (default) | on

params.name: CT and CQ Source
params.values: Dropdown to select the source of thrust and torque coefficient values ’Dialog’ (default) | ’Compute using BEMT’ | ’Ports’

params.name: Number of blades
params.values: Number of blades per rotor 2 (default) | nonzero positive scalar

params.name: Output computed CT and CQ
params.values: Output computed thrust coefficient and torque coefficient off (default) | on

params.name: Lift curve slope (per rad)
params.values: Lift curve slope 5.5 (default) | nonzero positive scalar

params.name: Twist distribution
params.values: Rotor blade twist distribution Linear (default) | Ideal

params.name: Blade root angle (rad)
params.values: Blade root pitch angle 0.2548 (default) | real scalar

params.name: Blade tip angle (rad)
params.values: Blade tip pitch angle 0.1018 (default) | real scalar
